#Functions
```{r}
make_geneList_kegg <- function(logFC_named_by_SYMBOL) {
  # SYMBOL -> ENTREZ mapping
  ids <- suppressMessages(
    bitr(names(logFC_named_by_SYMBOL),
         fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
  )
  
  v <- logFC_named_by_SYMBOL[ids$SYMBOL]
  names(v) <- ids$ENTREZID
  v <- v[!is.na(v) & !is.na(names(v))]
  
  # Deduplicate: Keep the entry with the highest absolute logFC for duplicate Entrez IDs
  df <- data.frame(entrez = names(v), logFC = v, absFC = abs(v), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df <- df[order(df$absFC, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  df <- df[!duplicated(df$entrez), ]
  
  gene_list <- df$logFC
  names(gene_list) <- df$entrez
  
  # Return sorted vector
  sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)
}

convert_core_enrichment <- function(entrez_string) {
  if (is.na(entrez_string) || entrez_string == "") return(NA)
  
  entrez_ids <- strsplit(entrez_string, "/")[[1]]
  
  # mapIds preserves vector order and size
  symbols <- suppressMessages(
    mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, 
           keys = entrez_ids, 
           column = "SYMBOL", 
           keytype = "ENTREZID", 
           multiVals = "first")
  )
  
  # Fallback: keep original Entrez ID if Symbol is missing
  symbols <- ifelse(is.na(symbols), entrez_ids, symbols)
  paste(symbols, collapse = "/")
}
```

#Samples preparation
```{r}
for (nm in names(subset_list)) {
  spe <- subset_list[[nm]]
  colData(spe)$sample_id <- rep(nm, ncol(spe))
  subset_list[[nm]] <- spe
}

combined_spe <- do.call(cbind, subset_list)
combined_myo <- combined_spe[,combined_spe$new_cell_type %in% c("Myonuclei_IIb", "Myonuclei_IIx",
                                      "Myonuclei_IIx_IIa","Myonuclei_IIx_IIb", "Myonuclei_MTJ",
                                      "Myonuclei_NMJ", "Myonuclei_Trim63")]

pb <- aggregateAcrossCells(combined_myo, use.assay.type = "counts",  ids=combined_myo$sample_id)
pb$tissue_type <- droplevels(pb$tissue_type)
```


```{r message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
y <- DGEList(counts(pb), samples = colData(pb))
keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = y$samples$tissue_type)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + tissue_type, data = y$samples)
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmFit(y, design)
se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = y$counts),
                           colData = y$samples)
assay(se, "norm") <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

gsea_list <- list()
dge_list <- list()

for (contrast_name in names(contrast_list)) {

  contrast <- makeContrasts(
    contrasts = contrast_list[[contrast_name]],
    levels = design
  )

  lrt <- glmLRT(fit, contrast = contrast)
  top <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  top$SYMBOL <- rownames(top)
  top$significant <- top$FDR < 0.05

  dge_list[[contrast_name]] <- top
  
  rowData(se)[[paste0("PVAL_", contrast_name)]]     <- top$PValue[match(rownames(se), rownames(top))]
  rowData(se)[[paste0("FC_", contrast_name)]]       <- top$logFC[match(rownames(se), rownames(top))]
  rowData(se)[[paste0("ADJ.PVAL_", contrast_name)]] <- top$FDR[match(rownames(se), rownames(top))]
  rowData(se)[[paste0("SYMBOL_", contrast_name)]]   <- top$SYMBOL[match(rownames(se), rownames(top))]

  geneList <- top$logFC
  names(geneList) <- top$SYMBOL
  geneList <- geneList[!is.na(geneList) & !is.na(names(geneList))]
  geneList <- make_geneList_kegg(geneList)

  gsea_sig <- gseKEGG(
    geneList = geneList,
    organism = "mmu",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  gsea_list[[contrast_name]] <- gsea_sig

  if (!is.null(gsea_sig) && nrow(gsea_sig@result) > 0) {
    gsea_sig@result$core_enrichment_symbols <-
      sapply(gsea_sig@result$core_enrichment, convert_core_enrichment)
    res_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_sig@result)
  
    # write.xlsx(
    #   res_df,
    #   file = paste0("GSEA_", contrast_name, ".xlsx"),
    #   rowNames = FALSE
    # )
  }
}
```

#Extracting info for barplot
```{r}
extract_pathway_degs <- function(pathway_description, 
                                 contrast_name = "STAT3_vs_C26", 
                                 gsea_res_list = gsea_list, 
                                 dge_res_list = dge_list) {
  
  gsea_df <- gsea_res_list[[contrast_name]]@result
  core_genes <- gsea_df$core_enrichment[gsea_df$Description == pathway_description]
  
  if (length(core_genes) == 0 || is.na(core_genes)) {
    warning(paste("Pathway non trovato nei risultati GSEA:", pathway_description))
    return(NULL)
  }
  gene_symbols <- convert_core_enrichment(core_genes)
  gene_vector <- unlist(strsplit(gene_symbols[1], "/"))
  
  top_df <- dge_res_list[[contrast_name]]
  
  res_df <- data.frame(
    Gene  = gene_vector,
    logFC = top_df[gene_vector, "logFC"],
    fdr   = top_df[gene_vector, "FDR"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  return(res_df)
}
```

```{r}
deg_data_auto <- extract_pathway_degs("Autophagy - animal")
deg_data_prot <- extract_pathway_degs("Proteasome")
deg_data_ubi <- extract_pathway_degs("Ubiquitin mediated proteolysis")
```

#barplot
```{r}
p <- ggplot(deg_data_prot, aes(x = reorder(Gene, - logFC), y = logFC, fill = fdr)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#1f77b4",   # Colore scuro per FDR più bassi (più significativi)
    high = "#aec7e8",  # Colore chiaro per FDR più alti
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(
    title = "Differentially Expressed Genes",
    x = "Gene Symbol",
    y = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change")
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8) # Dimensione adatta per 64 etichette
  )
print(p)
ggsave(
  filename = "deg_analysis_prot.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 12,   # 12 pollici garantiscono lo spazio verticale per 64 righe
  dpi = 300
)
```

#DOTPLOT GSEA MYO (only for c26 vs sham)
```{r}
p <- enrichplot::dotplot(gsea_myo_stat3_c26, showCategory = 15, font.size = 8,
                    title = "Enriched Pathways", split=".sign") + facet_grid(.~.sign)
ggsave("pathways_myo_stat3_c26.pdf", plot = p,
       width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300)

#second plot 
enrich_KEGG <- as.data.frame(gsea_myo_stat3_c26@result)
enrich_KEGG <- enrich_KEGG[order(enrich_KEGG$p.adjust), ]
enrich_KEGG <- enrich_KEGG[enrich_KEGG$p.adjust < 0.05, ]

enrich_KEGG$Count <- sapply(strsplit(enrich_KEGG$core_enrichment, "/"), length)
enrich_KEGG$GeneRatio <- enrich_KEGG$Count / enrich_KEGG$setSize

enrich_pos <- enrich_KEGG[enrich_KEGG$NES > 0, ]
enrich_neg <- enrich_KEGG[enrich_KEGG$NES < 0, ]

# grafico positivi
p_pos <- ggplot(enrich_pos,
                aes(x = -log10(p.adjust),
                    y = reorder(Description, -log10(p.adjust)),
                    color = GeneRatio,
                    size = Count)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  ylab("Description") +
  xlab("-log10(p.adjust)") +
  ggtitle("KEGG Positive Pathways")

ggsave("myo_stat3_c26_pos.pdf", plot = p_pos,
       width = 20, height = 9, dpi = 300)

# grafico negativi
p_neg <- ggplot(enrich_neg,
                aes(x = -log10(p.adjust),
                    y = reorder(Description, -log10(p.adjust)),
                    color = GeneRatio,
                    size = Count)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  ylab("Description") +
  xlab("-log10(p.adjust)") +
  ggtitle("KEGG Negative Pathways")

ggsave("myo_stat3_c26_neg.pdf", plot = p_neg,
       width = 20, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
